_comment: UTM (QEMU) VM spec for the Windows 11 EUD. TPM 2.0 is backed by swtpm — an EMULATED endorsement key (EK), not a manufacturer part. build-vm.sh renders this into the qemu-system-x86_64 + swtpm invocation UTM's GUI wraps; import the resulting disk into UTM (New VM > Existing image) if you want the GUI, or run headless with the printed command. Same mechanism a real fleet laptop uses — only the EK trust anchor differs (see ../windows-hello-for-business.md).
name: windows11-eud

tpm.note: swtpm mints its own EK + EK cert at first start — emulated, not manufacturer-signed. tpm_devid's endorsement_ca_path must point at swtpm's self-signed EK CA for this VM to attest (see spire-tpm-devid-values.yaml in platform/access), not a real TPM manufacturer root.

narration: virtual — emulated EK; mechanism identical to real fleet hardware (see README.md)
